facts.text: Omegro is a branded portfolio within Volaris Group, which is an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. It was formally launched on June 25, 2024, as a global collective of technology businesses from Volaris focused on permanent ownership and long-term sustainable growth.
Kevin Bradley and Troy O'Connor were named Co-CEOs at launch. Bradley is responsible for capital generation and O'Connor for capital deployment. Katie Mansell serves as Chief Financial Officer.
facts.source_title: Introducing Omegro: A Global Collective of Technology Businesses

facts.text: Omegro's businesses offer warehousing and inventory control, ERP and CRM, fleet and logistics management, asset maintenance, and process automation. In January 2026, Omegro announced a refined strategic focus on Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) software businesses.
facts.source_title: Omegro Announces Renewed Strategic Focus on Enterprise Asset Management

facts.text: Bradley has led successful software businesses across financial services, supply chain, and FMCG sectors. He joined Constellation Software over a decade ago through acquisition and has acquired and grown multiple businesses, becoming an expert on best practices for running world-class software businesses.
facts.source_title: Introducing Omegro: A Global Collective of Technology Businesses

facts.text: O'Connor has over 25 years in the software industry, starting in consulting before spending 10+ years as co-founder of a software business. He joined Constellation Software in 2017 via acquisition of Smartrak, where he was CEO. Smartrak provides location-based business intelligence and fleet management software.
facts.source_title: Introducing Omegro: A Global Collective of Technology Businesses

facts.text: Omegro is a buy-and-hold acquirer that never sells businesses, providing founders and professional CEOs with a permanent and safe home where they can continue their legacy and support permanent growth repeatable over the long term.
